tasks.name: Script-based Story Understanding
tasks.description: Use script knowledge representations to comprehend and make sense of narratives, dialogues, and sequential events by matching observed events to stored script templates and filling in missing information through inference
tasks.given: Agent possesses relevant scripts in memory that match the domain of the input story; input contains sufficient contextual cues to activate appropriate script
tasks.makes: Story is understood with all implicit information made explicit; agent can answer questions about unstated but implied events, motivations, and likely outcomes

tasks.name: Script construction
tasks.description: Build new script knowledge representations by identifying causally coherent sequences of events from experience and organizing them into the six-part script structure
tasks.given: Sufficient examples of similar event sequences are available; agent has capability to identify causal relationships and common patterns across instances
tasks.makes: New script is stored in memory and available for future story understanding and expectation generation; script is properly integrated into existing script hierarchy

tasks.name: Expectation Generation
tasks.description: Generate predictions about what should happen next in a situation based on activated scripts and current scene progression
tasks.given: Relevant script has been identified and activated for current situation; current position within script execution is determinable
tasks.makes: Agent has clear expectations that can guide attention and response to unexpected events; violations of expectations can be detected and processed

tasks.name: answer_story_questions
tasks.description: Answer questions about a story using script-based inference to fill in implicit information
tasks.given: story can be understood via scripts, questions are answerable from script knowledge
tasks.makes: accurate answers provided with script-based reasoning
